N-high.basis: Hampstead Heath head via Highgate, Stoke Newington and Hackney Wick to Abbey Mills, then the Northern Outfall to the Beckton penstocks (R-008, R-010, R-027)

N-low.basis: Pimlico and Chelsea head, carried in the Victoria Embankment to Abbey Mills where the low-level flows are lifted (R-008, R-025, R-099, R-101)

N-mid.basis: Kensal Green head via Kilburn, Camden and Old Ford to Abbey Mills and the outfall (R-008, R-027)

S-high.basis: Putney and Brixton heads via Camberwell and Deptford, then the Southern Outfall to Crossness (R-010, R-078, R-080)

S-low.basis: Lambeth and Battersea head, carried in the Albert Embankment to Deptford and lifted there (R-025, R-100, R-102)
